reuse.why: Plugs the rule into the existing getBulkEditableCategories used by all generated-amount actions, but parses the tag with its own FIXED_GROUP_TAG regex instead of the existing extractTagsFromText from shared/tags.

duplication.why: The #fixed lookup is defined once (getFixedGroupIds) and used by both paths; the only duplication is the hand-written tag regex and copyPreviousMonth's pre-existing parallel exclusion condition gaining one more clause.

placement.why: The rule sits in budget/actions.ts beside the other month-wide exclusions (hasSavedTemplates, getBulkEditableCategories).

scope.why: Only the fixed-group rule, the extra cat_group column and a release note.

maintainability.why: Easy to follow, but the exclusion set is still applied in two shapes (SQL+filter in getBulkEditableCategories, inline condition in copyPreviousMonth) and tag syntax may drift from the app's tag parser.

bypasses_abstraction.where: budget/actions.ts FIXED_GROUP_TAG regex bypasses shared/tags extractTagsFromText.

disguised_duplication.where: FIXED_GROUP_TAG re-expresses tag extraction from shared/tags.ts as a bespoke regex.

one_place.where: getFixedGroupIds in budget/actions.ts decides the #fixed rule; getBulkEditableCategories and copyPreviousMonth both use it.
